trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and it's healthy again. I also opened SEV2 incident INC-0001, which paged on-call.

- **Rollback:** v2.3.1, the latest deploy, was failing health checks in us-east, us-west and eu-west, with an error rate of 18%. v2.3.0 is the most recent release that was healthy in production. All three regions are now on v2.3.0, and the error rate is down to 0.2%.
- **Incident:** INC-0001 describes the failure and the rollback. It also notes that v2.3.1's release candidate had already failed in staging. It asks for two follow-ups: finding the root cause in v2.3.1, and reviewing why it went to production after failing in staging. The first attempt to create the incident failed with a temporary error (503). I retried with the same request ID, so there's only one incident and one page.

content.text: Most recent healthy production release is v2.3.0.
